description.description: A composite image containing two separate photographs. The top photo shows a soldier in desert camouflage and a helmet pointing a handgun at the forehead of a young Black man while holding the back of his neck. The young man is wearing a yellow t-shirt with a lion logo and a patterned shirt over it. The bottom photo shows a soldier in desert camouflage pants and a t-shirt kicking a Black child in the street while other people observe in the background.
